description: The string literal a `where` value becomes when call_metrics compares a column to it. DuckDB reads a backslash literally and escapes a quote by doubling it. Snowflake and Databricks read a backslash as an escape, so it is doubled. Databricks also joins adjacent literals, so `'O''Brien'` reads as `OBrien` there, and a quote is escaped with a backslash instead. A value the model writes therefore filters on the same string in either package.
